20085.new_name: Velvet Little Red Riding Hood Set
20085.desc:
The fairytale costume in velvet: a full set including the shawl, in red, one size for 40-60 kg. The shawl is the piece that carries the character - without it, red velvet is just a dress.

Velvet raises this above the standard polyester fairytale sets in both feel and photographs. The red is deep rather than bright, which suits the story being referenced.

  • Material: velvet
  • Includes: full set with shawl
  • Style: Little Red Riding Hood
  • Color: red
  • Sizing: one size, recommended 40-60 kg

One size for 40-60 kg. Add a basket from a corner shop and the costume is canonical.
20085.short: Red velvet Little Red Riding Hood costume with shawl included, one size for 40-60 kg, full fairytale set.

20101.desc:
Three-piece nurse set in polyester: dress, thong, and headband, one size for 40-60 kg. The cut-out open-chest construction is the design - it converts a standard nurse silhouette into something the category notices.

The headband keeps the costume legible despite the cut, which is the balance this genre has to strike. Polyester holds the cutout edges without fraying concerns.

  • Material: polyester
  • Includes: dress, thong, headband
  • Features: cut-out, open chest
  • Color: as pictured
  • Sizing: one size, recommended 40-60 kg

One size for 40-60 kg. For nurse-costume buyers who find the classic version too covered.

20101.tkd_desc: Polyester nurse uniform with cut-out open chest, dress, thong and headband. One size for 40-60 kg, three-piece costume as pictured.

Three-piece policewoman costume in polyester: top, skirt, and thong, one size for 40-60 kg. The authority-figure lineup on the site runs nurse, secretary, cheongsam, and police - this is the police entry.

The top-and-skirt construction is the classic format, and the thong arrives matching. No hat in this listing; the belt line and silhouette do the identifying work.

  • Material: polyester
  • Includes: top, skirt, thong
  • Style: policewoman
  • Color: as pictured
  • Sizing: one size, recommended 40-60 kg

One size for 40-60 kg. Add your own cap if the costume needs it - the set itself is complete for wear.

20122.tkd_desc: Polyester policewoman costume with top, skirt and thong, as pictured. One size for 40-60 kg, three-piece authority-figure set.

20185.desc:
A polyester sweater set with an open chest and open back, in white, gray, or black, one size for 40-60 kg. The listing runs two combos: sweater with stockings, or clothing only - the price follows the choice.

The bust range is printed at 70-120 cm with a 60-80 cm waist, generous for the category. The open-front and open-back construction makes this a cold-weather costume that does not overheat indoors.

  • Material: polyester
  • Includes: sweater, bracelet, stockings (combo option)
  • Features: open chest and back
  • Color: white, gray, or black
  • Sizing: one size, bust 70-120 cm, waist 60-80 cm, 40-60 kg

Choose the combo at order time - stockings match the sweater colorway, which is worth the coordination.
20185.short: Open-chest sweater set in three colors with optional matching stockings, bust 70-120 cm, one size for 40-60 kg.
20185.tkd_desc: Open-chest polyester sweater set with bracelet and optional stockings in white, gray or black. Bust 70-120 cm, one size for 40-60 kg.

20188.desc:
A one-piece knit sweater with a fully open back, in white, gray, or black, one size for 85-130 lbs. The single-garment approach means the costume is the sweater, full stop - pull it on and the look is decided.

Three colorways split the effect: white reads softest, black reads sharpest, gray sits between. The knit is polyester and machine-tractable, unlike wool costume knits.

  • Material: polyester knit
  • Item type: sweater
  • Features: backless
  • Color: white, gray, or black
  • Sizing: one size, 85-130 lbs

One size for 85-130 lbs. The simplest cold-month costume on the site - one piece, three colors, zero decisions beyond that.
20188.short: Backless knit sweater in white, gray or black, one size for 85-130 lbs, single-piece costume knit.
20188.tkd_desc: Backless one-piece knit sweater in white, gray or black. One size for 85-130 lbs, polyester costume knit for cold-month wear.

Deep-V cuts in this category usually arrive with a modesty layer; this one does not, which is the point of the listing. The fit runs true to the category standard.

  • Material: polyester
  • Item type: one-piece
  • Style: bunny girl, deep V, hollow out
  • Color: as pictured
  • Sizing: one size, recommended 40-60 kg

One size for 40-60 kg. The most committed neckline in the bunny category, for buyers who checked the pictures first.
